note: Reviewed Silver rules for the PSA small-area poverty estimates (D-034). The generator src/silver/psa_poverty_stat.py writes etl/03_silver/05_clean_psa_poverty_stat.sql, etl/03_silver/90_validate_psa_poverty_stat_clean.sql and docs/data/silver/psa-poverty-stat-clean.md from this file and config/ingestion/psa_poverty_stat.json. Change a rule here, then regenerate; tests/test_silver_psa.py fails until the files match.

grain.rule: One row per source unit (city or municipality row) per estimate year the delivery covers: the wide year columns are unpivoted, keeping each year's estimate, CV, SE and both 90% limits together.

identifier.finding: O-2: 1,073 of 1,612 IDs lost a leading zero because Excel stores them as numbers; the padded 6-digit form plus 000 equals the PSGC Correspondence Code for 1,612 of 1,612 rows (X-1). It is not the 10-digit PSGC code. The published value stays in Bronze.

Municipality/City.rule: Whitespace normalized, blank to NULL. Names, former names in parentheses and Bumbaran stay as published (O-10); matching names is Integration's job.

region_banner.rule: The label of the nearest region banner row above the unit, in Excel row order, within the same batch and sheet; never carried across deliveries. Not inferred from the ID prefix: Negros Island Region holds both 06 and 07 (O-3).

measures.name: poverty_incidence
measures.unit: percent of persons below the poverty threshold

numeric.rule: Matched exactly (no trimming), then cast to DOUBLE: the value Excel stored, with every digit Bronze kept and no rounding. Scientific notation is accepted. Blank or absent stays NULL, never 0. Anything else quarantines the row.
numeric.why_double: Excel stores every number as an IEEE-754 double, and Bronze keeps that double's digits as text (up to 17 significant digits, e.g. -2.4063453271442992E-2). DOUBLE holds exactly that value; a fixed-scale DECIMAL would round small values in scientific notation. Reconciliation compares the Silver value with CAST(Bronze text AS DOUBLE) exactly, with no tolerance.

bounds.finding: O-7: no estimate outside its interval and no upper limit over 100 in the profiled workbook

flags.finding_se: O-8: SE differs from incidence x CV / 100 by more than 0.05 in 6 (2018), 133 (2021, CALABARZON), 1 (2023) rows
flags.finding_lower: O-7: lower limit zero or negative in 3 estimates (2018 Adams 0, 2021 Port Area 0, 2023 Ivana -0.024)

quarantine.rule: Any quarantined row is WARN; more than 1% of a batch's estimate year is FAIL, as for DepEd enrollment (D-024).

not_carried.Region/Province: On unit rows it is a sparse, unreliable province label (1,527 of 1,612 blank; `(Continued)`; Maguindanao del Norte and del Sur share code 1538; O-3). It stays in Bronze; the official province comes from PSGC in Integration through correspondence_code. On region banner rows it is the source of `region`.
